propositions: The mcp compose service has no mechanism to provision or mount a ticket store, causing all tracker reads to return empty results.
The mcp Dockerfile copies the repo root but excludes .tickets-tracker via .dockerignore, and the docker-compose service declares no tracker volume or REBAR_TRACKER_DIR environment variable.

The deployed mcp endpoint at rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp serves a non-existent store, returning empty lists for list_tickets/search/ready_tickets and "ticket system not initialized" errors for fsck.

The mcp service must be configured with a dedicated ticket store volume, entrypoint provisioning logic (cloning the tickets branch), and credentials (MCP_TICKETS_PAT) to function as a full read-write tracker.

The provisioning pattern from the review-bot service (clone on boot via entrypoint, convergence script, dedicated volume) was not applied to mcp and must be replicated with a separate volume to avoid contention.
The ADR 0104-mcp-on-box.md must document the three design decisions: full read-write tracker access, dedicated /var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets volume, and fallback to reviewbot-tickets-pat credential.
